# Datum

> Datum is the open network cloud for AI — a neutral, programmable foundation for edge, inference, compute, and connectivity. A Kubernetes-style API, no feature gates. Available as public cloud, as Dedicated Cloud for scaled deployments, or as open source (AGPLv3). Currently free of charge to use; a valid payment method is required at signup.

General availability begins September 2026. Agents act through `datumctl` (a CLI built on the Kubernetes apiserver, also runnable as a local API proxy and an MCP server) or directly against the HTTP API at `https://api.datum.net`. The API is self-describing: `datumctl api-resources` lists every resource type and `datumctl explain <resource>` returns its schema, so an agent can learn the full surface at runtime.

## Act
- [Agent home](https://agents.datum.net): canonical, machine-readable entry point for agents.
- [llms-full.txt](https://www.datum.net/llms-full.txt): full technical reference — concepts, IAM, resource kinds, getting started.
- [Docs MCP](https://www.datum.net/docs/mcp): hosted MCP server to search and read Datum docs.
- [datumctl docs](https://www.datum.net/docs/datumctl): install, auth, commands, plugins.
- API base `https://api.datum.net`: Kubernetes-style paths, e.g. `/apis/resourcemanager.miloapis.com/v1alpha1/organizations`.
- Local authenticated gateway: `datumctl api proxy` serves the API on `127.0.0.1` with your session attached and auto-refreshed — no token handling.
- MCP: the `datumctl ai` toolset runs as an MCP server; an official self-hosted Datum MCP server integrates with Cursor.

## Core verbs (datumctl)
- `datumctl api-resources` — list every resource type.
- `datumctl explain <resource>[.<field.path>]` — schema and field docs (e.g. `datumctl explain httpproxies.spec`).
- `datumctl get | describe | diff | apply | delete` — read and manage resources. `apply` has conflict management and is safe to retry.
- `datumctl auth login --no-browser` — device-code login for SSH sessions, VMs, and containers.

## Pricing
Usage-based and transparent — no feature gates, no seat limits, no hidden fees. Every rate is published per unit, billing is per-second, and ingress is always free. Full rate card: [datum.net/pricing](https://www.datum.net/pricing) (markdown: https://www.datum.net/pricing.md).

Datum is free during public beta. We require a valid payment method during signup to head off fraud and abusive behavior, but you are not charged. We commit to advance notice and a grace period to review rates before any billing begins. If you prefer a demo, just [reach out](https://www.datum.net/contact/).

- Deliver: DNS (coming soon) $0.60 per million requests after the first 500K; ALB $1.00 per million requests; GSLB $0.60 per million requests.
- Build: Compute $0.0504 per vCPU-hour and $0.0162 per GiB-memory-hour (billed per second); Object Storage $0.0085 per GB-month (Standard) or $0.024 per GB-month (Performance).
- Connect: Gateways (coming Q3 2026) $0.045 per hour; Tunnels $0.01 per endpoint-hour; Public IPv4 $0.005 per IP-hour.
- Data transfer: egress free for the first 200 GB/month, then $0.05/GB to 10 TB, $0.04/GB to 150 TB, $0.03/GB to 500 TB, contact sales beyond 500 TB; internal same-region free, cross-region $0.03/GB.
